Questions & Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our steel almirahs, office cupboards, wholesale factory pricing, and pan-India delivery.

Our heavy-duty steel almirahs start from ₹4,500 for compact open industrial shelving units, ₹8,500 for designer loft dressing tables, and ₹11,000 to ₹12,999+ for standard 2-door and 3-door steel almirahs with locker systems. Modular enterprise sets start at ₹21,000. We also provide direct wholesale factory discounts for bulk corporate, school, and government orders.

For residential use and bedrooms, 2-door and 3-door steel almirahs with internal dual-locker security and mirror doors are the most popular choices. For enterprise workspaces, archives, and institutions, our 4-door heavy-gauge steel cupboards and multi-tier filing cabinets provide maximum organized capacity.

All Jagannath Enterprises products are engineered using certified Grade-A CRCA (Cold Rolled Close Annealed) industrial sheet steel (18 to 22 gauge). Every unit undergoes a rigorous 7-tank anti-rust chemical phosphating treatment and electrostatic powder coating baked at 200°C for lifetime corrosion resistance.

Yes. Our primary manufacturing hubs are located in New Delhi (Phase II Industrial Area) and Odisha (Jaraka, Jajpur). We have a dedicated enterprise logistics network supplying orders across 18+ Indian states with secure wooden crate packaging, doorstep unloading, and professional assembly.

All our steel furniture products come with a comprehensive 5-year structural warranty covering welds, sheet integrity, and high-security brass lock mechanisms. Replacement keys and technical support are available via our dedicated customer care team.

Yes! We regularly execute turnkey custom furniture manufacturing contracts for hospitals, banks, educational institutions, police departments, and IT offices. Custom shelf heights, secret lockers, glass doors, and special paint colors can be customized on request.
